title: Prorations
verified_concept: Quantity/plan changes create debit or credit adjustments; refund and immediate invoicing require explicit policy.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Net daily proration differences are consolidated model lines; contractions explicitly refunded or applied to AR.

title: Subscription revenue recognition
verified_concept: Invoice line service obligations are recognized over service time and can leave deferred revenue.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Daily closed-open periods with cumulative cent allocation; future rows are unearned schedules, never future actual GL.

title: Invoice line item object
verified_concept: Native API period semantics must be interpreted explicitly; line period relates to revenue allocation.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: This normalized flat dataset explicitly chooses end-exclusive calendar dates; it does not claim native API field semantics.

title: Payout reconciliation
verified_concept: Payouts settle batches of processor transactions; receipts and unsettled transactions are distinct.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Weekly fictional payouts and two business-day settlement; no claim to real processor timing or fee tariffs.

title: Billing analytics
verified_concept: Recurring revenue metrics and AR analysis are distinct reporting lenses.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: MRR/grace/discount policy is explicitly defined for this case, not asserted as every Stripe dashboard default.

title: Split cost allocation data
verified_concept: Shared cloud resource costs can be allocated to consuming workloads.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Custom monthly tenant workflow weights plus explicit shared portion; these CSVs are not native CUR exports.

title: Payroll fundamentals
verified_concept: Gross pay, net pay, employer cost and funding movements are separate concepts.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Fictional flat withholding/employer-tax assumptions and consolidated funding debit; not legal payroll rates.

title: Group analytics
verified_concept: Group analytics can aggregate events by organizations independently of user identities.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: One tenant/customer/subscription mapping with user-day and organization-day aggregates.

title: Deals API guide
verified_concept: Deal properties, associations and property history support tracking opportunities and stage changes.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Separate stage-entry extract and signed-contract map; expected pipeline remains uncontracted.

title: JournalEntry API reference
verified_concept: Accounting journal entries contain debit/credit distribution lines.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Complete modeled double-entry, separate opening TB and monthly account rollforwards; flat files are not native QBO exports.

title: Conversion windows
verified_concept: Conversion windows determine which interactions can receive attribution.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Case uses a modeled 30-day click window; platform totals are not cross-platform unique acquisitions.

title: Ads Action Stats
verified_concept: Ad reporting includes action metrics under attribution windows.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Modeled 7-day click/1-day view claims; source campaigns are only the SaaS company own marketing.

title: 2026 private B2B SaaS growth research
verified_concept: Original survey research provides context on company growth and retention dispersion.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Directional realism context only; synthetic prices, growth, retention and unit economics are independently specified, not survey estimates.

title: 2025 B2B SaaS retention benchmarks
verified_concept: Original research separates revenue retention and ACV peer groups.
case_model_choice_and_limitation: Useful context for reporting definitions; the generated cohort results are not claims of median benchmark performance.
